footnote_text: On November 18, 2026, pursuant to a Consent and Warrant Exchange Agreement dated November 15, 2026 (the "Consent Agreement"), between PharmaCyte Biotech, Inc. (the "Reporting Person") and Q/C Technologies, Inc. (the "Issuer"), the Reporting Person exchanged 851,304 Series G Long-Term Warrants for 4,982,272 shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share of the Issuer ("Common Stock"). The number of shares of Common Stock issued was determined based on the Black Scholes value of the exchanged warrants divided by $0.3101 per share, the closing price of the Common Stock on the last trading day prior to execution of the Consent Agreement. || Includes 169,728 shares of Common Stock acquired as payment of Series G Dividends exempt from Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, pursuant to Rule 16a-9(a) promulgated thereunder.
